court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sau. Jyotsnamala Ulhas Tawade vs State Of Maharashtra

parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra, Ulhas Ashraf Tawade (husband)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner was married to respondent on 12.07.2009. Petitioner filed Criminal Application No.22/2010 in the Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act. The learned Magistrate directed the respondent / husband to pay maintenance @ Rs.5678/- per month along with compensation to the tune of Rs.2 lakhs.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise agreement entered into before a Lok Adalat is binding and enforceable.
legal_principles.held: She herself has agreed for all the terms and conditions before the Lok Adalat, on which the Panel Members have verified the contents and passed the award.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot unilaterally challenge the award passed by a Lok Adalat.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner-lady has voluntarily entered into the compromise before the panel of Lok Adalat. She herself has agreed for all the terms and conditions before the Lok Adalat, on which the Panel Members have verified the contents and passed the award.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: The petitioner has claimed for recovery of arrears of maintenance amount.
